instruction: Use the right arm to pick up the knife from the knife holder, cut a small piece of sausage and put it back on the knife holder.
scope: 右臂取刀、切下新小段并归位；固定场景双视角视觉，空间/接触准备须独立验证

known_facts: 实测右臂六关节（排除夹爪维）运动状态=moving
右夹爪观测原始值 0.00460（数据集原始单位；不代表夹持成功）
state.expected_effect: 补充当前刀具、两指关系与香肠布局的清晰观测

joint_motion.units: source qpos/qvel units; physical units not verified
joint_motion.source: measured_joint_state; gripper excluded; no action or EEF

observation_inputs.sensor_relationship: joint positions and gripper share observation.state; velocity is measured qvel; not three independent sensors
